worker_claim.report: Focused recovery/workspace tests, the IPC server suite, compileall, and diff checks pass. The full pytest run exceeded the available command timeout, and Ruff is not installed in the environment.
worker_claim.summary: Added public owner-admission regressions for pre-worker recovery covering wrong ticket, wrong execution, stale observed HEAD rejection, and exact identity admission through submit_recover into the owner-side recovery operation. The tests verify invalid requests do not reach the recovery effect and valid requests preserve the exact recovery identity.
